styling.title: Evening
styling.text: Pair satin midis with a single gold earring and nothing else — let the drape do the talking.

styling.title: Day
styling.text: Wrap linens over a slip, add leather mules and a structured tote for effortless city dressing.

styling.title: Layering
styling.text: Velvet works over a fine knit or under a sharp blazer; keep everything tonal and quiet.
